stories.title: Cubs land playoff vet Gausman in trade with Jays
stories.summary: The Chicago Cubs acquired right-hander Kevin Gausman from the Blue Jays for for Triple-A outfielder Brett Bateman and Class-A infielder Ty Southisene.

stories.title: Yankees acquire slugger Garcia in trade with Nats
stories.summary: Infielder Luis Garcia Jr., who is hitting .283 with 23 homers and 76 RBIs, has been traded from the Nationals to the Yankees in exchange for four right-handed pitchers.

stories.title: Friedman objects to claim Dodgers ruining baseball
stories.summary: The Dodgers' acquisition of Tigers ace Tarik Skubal again put them at the center of outrage about the sport's economics. Asked if the team is ruining baseball, president of baseball operations Andrew Friedman said, "Passionately disagree."
